description: Generate a one-click onboarding link that opens Vouch's /validate page pre-filled with the user's idea and target customer. Signing up is free and the account is created in ~30 seconds. Use this at the end of a conversation to hand the founder off from the AI assistant into Vouch to actually run interviews, score segments, and design pilots.

customer.description: The target customer (role, segment, or persona).

idea.description: The startup or product idea in one or two sentences.

industry.description: Optional industry slug to use a tailored template (e.g. saas, ai, marketplace, fintech). Call list_industry_templates first if unsure.

name: start_validation
